clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Voxel-wise two-way ANOVA (group x dataset) on Z-score maps with TFCE correction; non-parametric Schreier-Ray-Hare tests and post-hoc tests on summary deviation metrics; Risk Ratios comparing HC vs patients; Spearman correlations with PANSS where available; ROC analysis of striatal FDOPA deviations predicting treatment response (AUC 0.77–0.83).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Psychosis cohorts show substantially higher and spatially heterogeneous FDOPA deviations than controls (~2–3x more extreme voxels), with limited overlap across patients (<~20%); harmonization via ComBat effectively mitigates scanner/site effects; striatal FDOPA deviations predict treatment response (AUC ~0.77–0.83).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Compared with HCs, patients had significantly more extreme deviations: RRpos=2.19 (95% CI: [1.97, 3.45]), RRneg=1.92 ([1.60, 3.00]), RRtot=2.60 ([1.36, 2.70]); overlap maps showed low common topology in HCs and heterogeneous patient patterns with maxima ~20% overlap. Voxel-wise analyses identified significant group-by-dataset interactions (e.g., Fpeak=21.71, pFWE<0.001) and group effects in frontal/temporal regions. ComBat reduced scanner/site differences versus smoothing/unharmonized data and was selected for FDOPA NM. FDOPA NM EV reached ~15%, with non-convergence (EXPV<0) in ~56% GM (threshold mask then applied, e.g., 3%). Striatal FDOPA deviations predicted treatment response with AUC 0.77–0.83.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Demonstrates feasibility of NM with molecular PET; introduces use of independent patient-only cohort (no matched HCs) leveraging normative reference; integrates automatic FDOPA kinetic pipeline and imaging-transcriptomics for biological interpretation.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Modest explained variance and substantial non-convergence across GM voxels, likely reflecting limited sample sizes and PET SNR; heavy reliance on ComBat harmonization for scanner/site effects; demographics (age/sex distributions) and some per-cohort Ns not clearly reported in text (likely in unparsed table), constraining fully transparent characterization.
